workflow_rationale: This is a feature workflow because we are integrating and completing existing bias detection infrastructure. Core components exist (models, calculators, UI) but need: (1) placeholder implementations replaced, (2) notification system integration, (3) admin configuration UI, (4) trend visualization, and (5) end-to-end integration. Each phase adds new capability in dependency order.

phases.name: Backend Integration & Placeholder Completion
phases.description: Complete placeholder implementations in fairness monitoring tasks and ensure proper database integration

subtasks.description: Replace placeholder database queries in fairness_monitoring.py with real implementations
subtasks.notes: Replaced all placeholder database queries in fairness_monitoring.py with real implementations. Created async helper functions using async_session_maker and asyncio.run() pattern for Celery compatibility. Updated calculate_fairness_metrics(), compare_demographic_outcomes(), monitor_fairness(), and generate_fairness_report() functions. Created comprehensive test suite in test_fairness_monitoring.py with tests for all main functions. All changes follow patterns from fairness_calculator.py and email_task.py.

subtasks.description: Implement missing demographic analyzer integration for automatic demographic inference
subtasks.notes: Fixed 6 type hint syntax errors in demographic_analyzer.py (changed Tuple[Optional[str, float, Dict]] to Tuple[Optional[str], float, Dict] for all inference methods). Created comprehensive test suite in test_demographic_analyzer.py with 13 test classes covering: gender inference, age group detection, ethnicity inference, geographic region detection, education level, career stage, bias indicators, name extraction, and full integration flows. All changes follow patterns from fairness_calculator.py and test_fairness_monitoring.py. Total: 585 lines added (2 files changed).

subtasks.description: Create Celery beat schedule for automated fairness monitoring

verification.command: python -c "from celery_beat_schedule import celery_schedule; assert 'monitor_fairness_metrics' in celery_schedule; print('OK')"

subtasks.notes: Added fairness monitoring schedule to Celery Beat configuration. Created get_fairness_monitoring_schedule_config() helper function with configurable settings (enabled, daily_hour=4, daily_minute=0, lookback_days=30, alert_threshold=0.8). Added monitor_fairness_metrics scheduled task that runs daily at 4 AM, routes to learning queue with 1-hour expiry. Created celery_schedule alias for verification compatibility. Updated module docstring, logging, and __all__ exports. Follows exact pattern from existing tasks (retraining, analytics, search alerts).

phases.name: Notification System Integration
phases.description: Integrate fairness alerts with notification system to send emails and in-app notifications when bias thresholds are exceeded

verification.instructions: Verify template renders correctly with sample data

subtasks.notes: Created notification templates for bias alerts (email and in-app). Added format_bias_alert_email() function and send_bias_detection_alert() Celery task in backend/tasks/notifications.py. Created HTML email template backend/templates/emails/bias_alert.html with severity-based styling, fairness metrics display, and actionable recommendations. Created verification test script backend/test_bias_notification.py. Manual verification completed - all patterns match existing notification code. Template renders correctly with sample data.

subtasks.description: Integrate fairness alert creation with notification sending in fairness_monitoring.py
subtasks.notes: Integrated fairness violation detection with notification system in fairness_monitoring.py. Modified monitor_fairness() to trigger send_fairness_alert.delay() when violations detected, added alerts_sent counter, created violation_details with demographic_group/violation/metrics/timestamp, added error handling. Created comprehensive integration test suite in backend/tests/integration/test_fairness_notifications.py with 5 test cases covering: violation triggers notification, no notification when no violations, email formatting, violation detection logic, and multiple violations. Follows pattern from notifications.py for async task triggering. Total: 491 lines added (2 files changed).

subtasks.description: Add API endpoint for marking bias alerts as acknowledged
subtasks.notes: API endpoint already implemented and fully functional. The POST /api/fairness/alerts/{alert_id}/acknowledge endpoint exists at lines 1210-1288 in backend/api/fairness.py. Implementation includes: query for alert by ID, 404 error if not found, updates alert.status to "acknowledged", sets alert.acknowledged_at timestamp, commits changes, returns JSON response with alert_id/acknowledged/acknowledged_at fields. Follows exact patterns from existing fairness.py endpoints. Originally implemented in commit f13cb1e. No additional code changes needed.

subtasks.description: Create API endpoints for managing bias alert configuration
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive CRUD API for bias alert configuration management. Implemented 5 endpoints (GET list, GET by ID, POST create, PUT update, DELETE) in backend/api/bias_alert_config.py. Added Pydantic models (BiasAlertConfigCreate, BiasAlertConfigUpdate, BiasAlertConfigResponse, BiasAlertConfigListResponse) for request/response validation. Features include query filters (organization_id, alert_type, is_enabled), pagination support (1-1000, default 100), comprehensive error handling (404, 422, 500), proper logging, ISO 8601 timestamps, and JSON field handling. Updated backend/api/__init__.py to import/export bias_alert_config module. Updated backend/main.py to register router at /api/bias-alert-config. Follows exact patterns from backend/api/fairness.py. Code is syntactically correct and ready for integration testing. Committed in 53226b8.

subtasks.description: Build BiasAlertConfiguration component for admin UI
subtasks.notes: Created BiasAlertConfiguration component and biasAlertConfig API client following established patterns. Implemented frontend/src/api/biasAlertConfig.ts with comprehensive CRUD operations (getConfigs, getConfig, createConfig, updateConfig, deleteConfig), TypeScript interfaces matching backend Pydantic models, and proper error handling. Created frontend/src/components/BiasAlertConfiguration.tsx with admin UI features: card-based list view, create/edit dialog with validation, toggle enable/disable, delete with confirmation, real-time threshold updates, severity indicators, notification settings. Uses MUI components (Paper, Card, Dialog, TextField, Select, Switch) following FairnessScorecard.tsx patterns. Full TypeScript type safety, responsive grid layout, proper error handling and user feedback. Total: 1038 lines added (2 files created). Committed in 768e487.

phases.name: Fairness Trends Over Time
phases.description: Add historical trend visualization to bias detection dashboard showing fairness metrics evolution

subtasks.description: Create API endpoint for historical fairness metrics (time series data)
subtasks.notes: Created GET /api/fairness/trends endpoint for historical fairness metrics time series data. Implemented FairnessTrendDataPoint and FairnessTrendsResponse Pydantic models. Added endpoint with required start_date/end_date parameters and optional filters (model_name, model_version, protected_attribute). Query aggregates metrics by analysis_date using SQLAlchemy func.avg() for all fairness metrics (disparate_impact_ratio, demographic_parity_diff, equal_opportunity_diff, average_odds_diff, theil_index) and func.sum() for sample_size. Returns chronological time series with proper date validation, error handling, and ISO 8601 timestamps. Follows patterns from analytics.py endpoints. Total: 191 lines added. Committed in 790a9d5.

subtasks.description: Build FairnessTrendsChart component with line chart for metrics over time
subtasks.notes: Created FairnessTrendsChart.tsx component with Recharts line chart displaying 5 fairness metrics over time (Disparate Impact Ratio, Demographic Parity Diff, Equal Opportunity Diff, Average Odds Diff, Theil Index). Features include: period selector (7d/30d/90d), interactive tooltips with metric values and sample sizes, custom tooltip component, loading/error/empty states, average values display for selected period, single data point handling. Integrated into FairnessMonitoring page as third "Trends" tab. Supports optional filters (modelName, modelVersion, protectedAttribute). Follows patterns from PerformanceMetricsChart.tsx and FairnessDashboard.tsx. Uses fairness.getTrends() API with date range calculation. Total: 650 lines added (2 files changed). Committed in 3cb8b56.

Integrated FairnessTrendsChart component into BiasDetectionDashboard page. Added import for FairnessTrendsChart component and created new 'Fairness Trends Over Time' section below the main FairnessDashboard. Component configured with defaultPeriod='30d' for consistency with existing date range filter. The trends chart includes built-in period selector (7d/30d/90d), interactive tooltips, and displays all five fairness metrics over time. Total: 6 lines added (1 file changed). Committed in c2e8466.
